ball.note: The BDB source tracks the football, but this seed only uses its snap position and does not model its future path.

continuity.use_limit: These values bridge 2025 to 2026 only; they do not establish 2022-to-2026 movement-system continuity.

execution_limit: The role-prior waypoints are passed through the unchanged 120 Hz Player.locomote() using each current player's physics profile. Other-player geometry is only snap-time nearest-opponent context; there is no post-snap assignment response or collision handling. Madden-style ratings are retained as current roster attributes, but no 2022-to-2026 ratings-to-motion mapping is calibrated.

historical_movement_source.movement_prior: league role/context residual; historical NE/CHI team residual shown but withheld from current generated paths
historical_movement_source.template_use: snap alignment and pre-snap motion history only; a non-CHI defense template is a league-role reconstruction

lineup_selection.claim_limit: synthetic lineup and slot assignment; the snapshot does not identify a verified starting 22 or assignment sheet
lineup_selection.rule: available roster players with the highest estimated overall within the required positional role counts
lineup_selection.within_role_slot_order: current players ranked by estimated overall are mapped in order to historical template players sorted by lateral alignment

play_selection.claim_limit: Combination of recorded labels; not evidence of a literal call, route, blocking scheme, or full alignment.

status: research reconstruction; no play outcome generated
